title: fix(console,plugin-form,i18n): the public form page and the master-detail form chrome speak the user's language (objectui#11071)
body:
Fixes #11071

Clause-②: no

## What

objectui#11039 moved the form family's feedback chrome onto the locale packs and left two halves behind. Under a zh session the console form page's action chrome and plugin-form's master-detail chrome still rendered English literals. They now read the catalogue, in all ten packs. Only defaults move: every authored value still wins where it did, and English output is byte-identical to the literals it replaces.

## Where each string goes

Console form page (`apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`, through `useObjectTranslation`):

| String | Key | |
|---|---|---|
| `Submit` | `publicForm.submit` | reused |
| `Submitting…` | `publicForm.submitting` | reused |
| `Uploading…` | `fields.file.uploading` | reused: the key the upload gate's in-flight Save label already reads |
| `Redirecting…` | `publicForm.redirectPending` | new: `publicForm.redirecting` is the embeddable form's countdown and carries a seconds hole this page has no value for |
| `Required: …` | `publicForm.requiredFields` | new, ONE key with a fields hole; the labels are joined with the existing `validation.formInvalidJoiner`, so colon, spacing, separator and word order are the locale's |

`wizard.missingRequired` was the other candidate for the refusal. It is a different sentence ("Please complete the required fields: …"): reusing it would rewrite the page's English wording and the existing `Required: Priority` pin, so the refusal takes its own key.

plugin-form (through the form family's `createSafeTranslation` tables):

| String | Key | |
|---|---|---|
| `Loading columns…`, `Subtotal`, `Tax (N%)`, `Total`, `Line item`, `Line item — row N`, `Apply` | `form.masterDetail.*` | new (the row title is one key with title and row holes; an authored collection `title` still fills the title) |
| `Add` (in-form collection default) | `detail.add` | reused |
| `Close` (row editor) | `common.close` | reused |
| `Saving…` (Save button in flight) | `detail.saving` | reused |
| `ModalForm` master-detail sr-only description | `form.masterDetail.editorDescription` | new |
| `ObjectForm` locked-field hint | `form.deniedDescription` | new |

New keys: 11 in each of the ten packs (`en` first, the nine translations in the same change). The rows of the plugin-form defaults tables repeat the `en` values, which `check:i18n-keys` holds them to.

## Measured under zh before changing (the source-read-only half)

At the parent commit, under a zh session, every site rendered English: the totals stack read `Subtotal` / `Tax (0%)` / `Total`; the in-form add button `Add`; the row editor `Line item — row 1` with `Close` and `Apply` (beside an already-localised 取消, which is untouched); the placeholder `Loading columns…`; the Save button in flight `Saving…`; the master-detail dialog's accessible description and the read-only field's hint were the English sentences. No string among them was already localised, so none was left standing.

## Pins

- `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.chromeI18n-11071.test.tsx`: zh render of the submit button, the in-flight button, the button during an upload, the pending redirect, the required refusal (page and toast), two labels joined with the pack separator; `CONTROL` authored field label inside the localised frame; `en` case.
- `packages/plugin-form/src/formChrome.i18n-11071.test.tsx`: zh render of the totals stack, the columns placeholder, the in-form Add and the row editor (title, Apply, Close), the in-flight Save, the modal description, the locked-field hint; `CONTROL` authored `title` and `addLabel`, authored dialog `description`, authored field `description`.
- objectui#11066's pin (`FormPage.chromeI18n-11039.test.tsx`) now submits through the button's localised name (`提交` in zh, `Submit` in en) instead of the `/Submit/` query.

Reverse verification (fix committed first, consumer files put back to the pinned base commit, restored with `git checkout HEAD` and proven by an empty `git diff HEAD` and equal blob hashes): the three pin files went 17 failed, 5 passed of 22. The direction is the ordinary one: every zh case red, the five that stay green are the `en` cases, the loading line that was already localised, and the two authored-value controls that never depended on the change.

## Deviations, stated

- Five sibling console tests (`FormPage.avatarUpload-10785`, `.fileField`, `.recordObject`, `.serverDefaults`, `.sharedWidgets-10179`) gained the same `createI18n` line in `beforeEach` that objectui#11066 gave its siblings. They click the submit button by its English name and mount no i18n instance, so the button now rendered its raw key (15 tests red before the line). This is outside the claim's declared file surface; it is harness-only.
- `Close` on the row editor was not in the card's list. It sits in the same card as `Line item — row N` and `Apply`, in a declared file, is the same defect class, a mechanical move onto the existing `common.close`, has no other claim on the file, and is pinned by the zh row-editor case.

## Acceptance notes

- `LineItemsPanel.tsx` (the `record:line_items` panel) carries the same class and is outside this card's file surface. Measured with a temporary probe under zh at this head: `Save`, `Saving…` and the default title `Line Items` render English, and so does `Add line` from the fields package's grid. Left for the family close-out.
- The totals stack formats money with a hard-coded `¥`; `formFaces.displayLocale-9909.test.tsx` pins it as it is. Untouched.

## Local verification

Run in the foreground at head ae1166668 (exit codes read from the runs):

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/ packages/i18n/`: 219 files, 2944 passed, 14 skipped.
- Console: `apps/console/src/components/FormPage*` plus `submitRedirect`, `createdRecordPath`, `formPageRequiredMarker-10178`, `internalFormShell`, `App.uploadAltitude-10131`, `App.docsPortalLazy`, `formViewFeaturesRootRefused-6262`: 33 files, 354 passed. Neighbouring renderers of plugin-form (`ObjectCalendar.expandGate-6453`, `ObjectView.expandGate`, `catalog-gallery-render`, `RecordFormPage`): 6 files, 634 passed.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/plugin-form`, `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/console` (their dependency closures built first with turbo): exit 0 each; both new test files are in their test programs.
- `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `changeset:check`: exit 0. `check-governed-queue-guard` answers NOT GOVERNED for the 24 changed paths.
- `eslint` on the 23 changed ts and tsx files: 0 errors, 118 warnings.
- NOT MEASURED here: the rest of the CI farm.
